leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Promise object to handle asynchronous operations
Apply .then() and .catch() methods to process Promise resolutions and rejections
Implement async functions to write asynchronous code with synchronous-like syntax
Manipulate multiple Promises using Promise.all() for concurrent execution
Initialize error handling within async/await patterns using try...catch blocks
Integrate Promise-based APIs with async/await to fetch and process data
